title: Microsoft to report Q4 earnings as investors look for return on AI investments
excerpt: Microsoft will report its Q4 earnings after the bell on Wednesday.
content_html:
Microsoft (MSFT) will report its fourth quarter earnings after the bell on Wednesday as the parade of Big Tech earnings announcements marches on.

Shares of the Windows developer have declined more than 18% since the start of the year as investors question the company's AI spending and look for signs that Microsoft is seeing strong returns on its massive investments.

Rivals Amazon (AMZN) and Google (GOOG, GOOGL) are up less than 1% and more than 3%, respectively, during the same period.

Microsoft, like much of the tech industry, has been beset by concerns about aggressive capital expenditure and its impact on the company's free cash flow, as well as whether those investments are paying off in terms of improved revenue.

But Microsoft is also capacity-constrained, making it unable to meet demand for its AI services. Investors, however, could balk at further spending increases even if they could help ease those constraints.

Last week, Google parent Alphabet said it plans to spend between $195 billion and $205 billion on capex for the year, up from its prior estimate of $180 billion to $190 billion and well ahead of analysts' expectations of $186.4 billion. That sent Alphabet stock tumbling more than 6% on the day.

For the quarter, Microsoft is expected to spend $35.2 billion on capex excluding capital leases, up 106% year over year, according to Bloomberg data.

In a note to investors, BofA Global Research's Tal Liani wrote that Microsoft will have to show Azure cloud growth of 39% to 40% or better to help calm spending-related jitters.

Cantor's Thomas Blakey, however, stated in an investor note that he believes capex growth will slow in Microsoft's fiscal 2027 after coming in higher than anticipated in its fiscal 2026.

Overall, Microsoft is expected to post earnings per share of $4.25 on revenue of $87.7 billion, topping the $3.65 and $76.4 billion the company saw in Q4 last year.

The company's Intelligent Cloud segment is projected to bring in $38.1 billion, a 12% increase from the same period last year. Azure revenue is estimated to reach $39.5 billion.

Remaining performance obligations, or contracts Microsoft must still deliver on, are expected to grow 72% to $647.6 billion.

Microsoft's Business Productivity and Business Processes segment is anticipated to see revenue of $37.3 billion, up 12.5%, while its More Personal Computing business revenue is expected to decline 9.5% to $12.1 billion.

content_html_zh:
微软（MSFT）将于周三收盘后公布第四季度收益，大型科技公司的收益公告将继续进行。

自今年年初以来，这家 Windows 开发商的股价已下跌超过 18%，因为投资者质疑该公司的人工智能支出，并寻找微软在其大规模投资中看到强劲回报的迹象。

竞争对手亚马逊 (AMZN) 和谷歌 (GOOG, GOOGL) 同期分别上涨不到 1% 和超过 3%。

与许多科技行业一样，微软也一直担心激进的资本支出及其对公司自由现金流的影响，以及这些投资是否在收入增加方面得到回报。

但微软也面临产能限制，无法满足人工智能服务的需求。 然而，即使进一步增加支出有助于缓解这些限制，投资者也可能会犹豫不决。

上周，谷歌母公司 Alphabet 表示，计划今年的资本支出为 1950 亿美元至 2050 亿美元，高于之前预计的 1800 亿美元至 1900 亿美元，也远高于分析师预期的 1864 亿美元。 这导致 Alphabet 股价当日暴跌逾 6%。

据彭博社数据，微软本季度预计将花费 352 亿美元的资本支出（不包括资本租赁），同比增长 106%。

美国银行全球研究部的 Tal Liani 在给投资者的一份报告中写道，微软必须展示 Azure 云增长 39% 至 40% 或更好，才能帮助平息与支出相关的紧张情绪。

然而，Cantor 的托马斯·布莱基 (Thomas Blakey) 在一份投资者报告中表示，他认为微软 2027 财年的资本支出增长将在 2026 财年高于预期之后放缓。

总体而言，微软预计每股收益为 4.25 美元，营收为 877 亿美元，高于去年第四季度的 3.65 美元和 764 亿美元。

该公司的智能云部门预计将带来381亿美元的收入，比去年同期增长12%。 Azure 收入预计将达到 395 亿美元。

剩余的履约义务，或者微软仍必须履行的合同，预计将增长 72%，达到 6,476 亿美元。

微软的商业生产力和业务流程部门的收入预计将达到 373 亿美元，增长 12.5%，而其更多个人计算业务的收入预计将下降 9.5%，至 121 亿美元。
